security.apiKeyHandling: Server-side proxy routes only via process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY
security.clientExposures: Zero API keys or secrets exposed to browser

researchWorkflow.name: Query Formulation & Topic Decomposition
researchWorkflow.description: Deconstructs the user-provided research topic into targeted Boolean queries and academic keyword permutations covering foundational theory, contemporary empirical benchmarks, and methodological paradigms.

researchWorkflow.name: Live Literature Grounding via Google Search
researchWorkflow.description: Executes real-time search grounding using Gemini 3.8 Flash to retrieve authoritative preprints (arXiv, bioRxiv), peer-reviewed publications (Nature, Science, IEEE, PubMed/NCBI), and institutional whitepapers.

researchWorkflow.name: Evidence Synthesis & Comparative Benchmarking
researchWorkflow.description: Synthesizes multi-corpus findings into rigorous scientific prose, formulating comparative Markdown benchmark tables contrasting throughput, accuracy, algorithmic complexity, and empirical limitations.

researchWorkflow.name: Anti-Hallucination Citation Verification
researchWorkflow.description: Extracts groundingChunks from API response metadata. Cross-references all in-text bracketed markers ([1], [2], etc.) against confirmed web URIs to prevent fabricated DOIs or fictitious authors.

researchWorkflow.name: Publication-Grade Document Assembly & Section Indexing
researchWorkflow.description: Structures the final manuscript into standardized academic sections (Abstract, Introduction, Methodology, Findings, Discussion, Conclusion, References) and indexes metadata for export to Markdown, Plain Text, BibTeX, and PDF.

citationVerificationRules.name: Zero Citation Hallucination
citationVerificationRules.description: The agent is strictly prohibited from fabricating, hallucinating, or guessing citation titles, authors, DOIs, journal names, or web addresses.

citationVerificationRules.name: Grounding Source Provenance
citationVerificationRules.description: Every cited work in the References section must correspond to a verified web source retrieved via Google Search grounding metadata (groundingChunks).

citationVerificationRules.name: Strict In-Text Mapping
citationVerificationRules.description: In-text citation markers ([1], [2], etc.) must maintain a 1:1 bidirectional alignment with the numbered References list.

citationVerificationRules.name: Objective Conflict Reporting
citationVerificationRules.description: Where scientific literature exhibits divergent benchmarks or conflicting findings, both perspectives must be documented in the Discussion section with their respective verified references.

citationVerificationRules.name: Format Adherence
citationVerificationRules.description: References must be formatted in accordance with the user's requested standard (APA 7th, IEEE, Chicago, Harvard, or BibTeX) and must include direct source URLs.
